children: RISHON LE ZION, Israel, Sept. 08, 2026
-- BOS Better Online Solutions Ltd. ("BOS" or the "Company")

, an integrator of supply chain technologies for the aerospace, defense, industrial and retail sectors, today announced that Eyal Cohen, CEO, will present and host one-on-one meetings with investors at Sidoti’s Small-Cap Virtual Investor Conference, taking place on September 23-24, 2026.
The presentation will begin at 8:30 AM ET on September 24, 2026 and can be accessed live here:
BOS will also host virtual one-on-ones with investors on Wednesday and Thursday, September 23-24, 2026. To register for the presentation or one-on-ones, visit
. Registration is free and you don't need to be a Sidoti client.
About Sidoti

Sidoti & Company, LLC ("Sidoti") is an independent equity research firm that has spent over 25 years focused exclusively on small- and micro-cap public companies, covering approximately 110 companies mostly in the $200 million–$5 billion market-cap range. Sidoti Events, LLC runs investor conferences connecting small- and micro-cap issuers like BOS with its network of 2,500+ institutional investors across North America.
About BOS

BOS integrates cutting-edge technologies to streamline and enhance supply chain operations for global customers in the aerospace, defense, industrial and retail sectors. The Company operates three specialized divisions:
Supply Chain Division
Distributes and integrates franchised electronic components directly into customer products.
RFID Division
Optimizes customers' inventory management through state-of-the-art marking and tracking solutions, ensuring real-time visibility and control.
Intelligent Robotics Division
Automates industrial and logistics inventory processes through advanced robotics technologies, improving efficiency and precision.
For more information on BOS Better Online Solutions Ltd., visit www.boscom.com.
